The decision over which extension to invoke may also be delegated to an LLM 'agent' to dynamically determine based on input prompt or LLM output. Agent-based systems will typically make repeated calls to an LLM using output from previous invocations to ground and direct subsequent invocations. Excessive Agency is the vulnerability that enables damaging actions to be performed in response to unexpected, ambiguous or manipulated outputs from an LLM, regardless of what is causing the LLM to malfunction.
